title: The molecular landscape of chordoma: Current frontiers from multi-omics to artificial intelligence.
authors: Tecimel, Didem; Seven, Didem; Ture, Ugur; Bayrak, Omer Faruk
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Reviews on cancer
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦脊索瘤的多组学与AI诊疗进展，虽提及Brachyury转录因子但未涉及TF-DNA结合互作建模，方法上仅泛述深度学习用于影像分割与生存预测，与本课题核心关联薄弱。
abstract: Chordoma is a rare and aggressive malignant bone tumor of the axial skeleton that has historically challenged clinicians due to its complex anatomical locations and a high recurrence rate of up to 85%. This review synthesizes the most recent advances in chordoma research and offers an overview of how multi-omics, advanced immunology, and artificial intelligence are reshaping the treatment paradigm. Central to its pathogenesis is the T-box transcription factor Brachyury, which this review highlights as both the pathognomonic diagnostic marker and the primary therapeutic vulnerability. Cutting-edge innovations targeting this driver include covalent small-molecule binders, targeted protein degradation, and peptide-centric CAR-T cells designed to attack the intracellular oncoprotein. The tumor immune microenvironment is functionally dynamic, and new dimensions in cellular therapy, such as dual-specific CAR constructs and NK-cell platforms, are being engineered to neutralize immunosuppressive factors. Beyond biological insights, the review emphasizes the role of computational biology, specifically how deep-learning and machine-learning models achieve expert-level precision in tumor segmentation and personalized survival forecasting. By integrating genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic data, multiomics approaches can fully elucidate chordoma subtypes and underlying resistance mechanisms, ultimately paving the way for more precise and personalized therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 脊索瘤是一种罕见的、侵袭性的中轴骨骼恶性骨肿瘤，因其复杂的解剖位置和高达85%的高复发率，历来对临床医生构成挑战。本综述综合了脊索瘤研究的最新进展，并概述了多组学、先进免疫学和人工智能如何重塑治疗范式。其发病机制的核心是T-box转录因子Brachyury，本综述强调其既是特征性诊断标志物，也是主要的治疗脆弱点。针对这一驱动因子的前沿创新包括共价小分子结合剂、靶向蛋白降解以及设计用于攻击细胞内癌蛋白的肽中心CAR-T细胞。肿瘤免疫微环境在功能上是动态的，细胞疗法的新维度，如双特异性CAR构建体和NK细胞平台，正在被工程化以中和免疫抑制因子。除生物学见解外，综述还强调了计算生物学的作用，特别是深度学习（deep-learning）和机器学习（machine-learning）模型如何在肿瘤分割和个性化生存预测中实现专家级精度。通过整合基因组、转录组、表观基因组和蛋白质组数据，多组学方法能够全面阐明脊索瘤亚型和潜在耐药机制，最终为更精准和个性化的治疗策略铺平道路。
